mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which is a precursor to economic slowdown and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3 percentage points and PAYEMS falls by more than 100k in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) coupled with a rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 declines by more than 1% YoY.
